7421.title: Account collection errors discard current state and reuse obsolete usage
7421.rootCauseOneLine: fetchResource throws on a valid per-account error before updating the cache; readUsage retains the old row state and turns the failure into a group-wide notice.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed Account Pooler-only change does not alter the Provider usage error/cache path; branch not executed.

7421.proposedFix: Separate valid per-account error states from transport failures, with an explicit product decision on retained successful values and row-local stale metadata.
7421.caveats: Synthetic source through real RPC and production static rendering, repeated in two clean checkouts. No live account/app verification; complete regression source is inline rather than a separate artifact, per reports repository policy.
